package.name: hyper_camera
package.description: USB camera driver nodes for HYPER's two physical USB cameras: the front ELP (rectified, C++ rclcpp component) and the Logitech C920 used for object detection (Python node). Each publishes a plain sensor_msgs/Image topic instead of the consumer node opening the device itself, so lane_detection can load the ELP publisher into the same component container for zero-copy intra-process delivery. Also the distribution point for every real camera's calibration/config files.
